headline: Sherwin-Williams Shares Jump After Earnings Beat and Higher Full-Year Outlook
summary: Sherwin-Williams Company (NYSE:SHW) shares climbed more than 5% in pre-market trading on Tuesday after the paints and coatings manufacturer reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter results and increased its full-year earnings guidance despite a subdued demand environment. The company delivered higher revenue and profit, supported by continued market share gains, strategic investments and contributions from acquisitions.
